last_summary: Best-supported chronology is v4 fresh bok choy/prep, then v3 cutting and separating bok choy with initial red-paste coating, then v2 mixing the white strips/stems with red paste, then v1 packed coated greens. The unresolved container identity and paste-stage ambiguity do not outweigh the visible progression from raw/cut greens to mixed paste to packed greens.
